tipo_cuenta: creator (Instagram Creator, TikTok Personal, any YouTube channel): keeps access to in-app music libraries
audiencia: Scrollers 16-34 who like art, music and pop culture told like gossip: curious, irreverent, allergic to lectures.
tono: A sarcastic, confident art-toy host spilling the tea on an artist: fast, cheeky, funny first, then one real surprising fact. Never a museum voice.
mensaje: Art is weirder and more alive than school made it look. Every episode ends with a two-option question and a joke.
concepto: Each episode celebrates one artist (classic painters first, music artists later). A floating 3D art-toy presenter tells the story to camera, intercut with the artist's work, a bricolage portrait of the artist and a quote card.

fuentes.marca: Bahnschrift-Light (kinetic type wall, labels; ships with Windows)

chica.nombre: Brielle - Podcast girl (already in the ElevenLabs account)
chica.qa: similarity to the Bosch series voice 0.90-0.94 (TTS) and 0.94 (STS from the Seedance voice, timing kept 10.00 -> 9.98 s); f0 ~225 Hz vs 215
notas: STS output comes out ~-27 LUFS: level it with the TTS lines (~-17) before the mix
TTS runs ~2.0-2.8 words/s: speed the voice-over 1.1x in montaje to reach the reference 2.6

chico.nombre: Young Jamal (shared library; usable by id)
chico.qa: f0 ~88 Hz, 2.35 words/s, Whisper match 0.91; no reference recording of the guy exists, chosen by description (young Black American, casual, social media)

voz.flujo: host clips: the clip's own generated voice drives the lips, then ElevenLabs speech-to-speech to the series voice (engine/sts.py); voice-over lines: ElevenLabs v3 straight (engine/tts.py)
voz.ritmo: about 2.6 words a second, pauses under a second, [laughs] allowed

musica.en_exportacion: none: the export carries voice-over + code-made sound effects only
musica.en_app: the song is added inside each app at the chosen start point (creator account libraries); edit against a muted guide track
musica.guia: playful upbeat indie / hip-hop beat, 95-110 BPM, bright plucks and light drums, no vocals under the voice
musica.sonidos: code-made pops, swishes, a hit on the cutout's first impact, ticks (Motion DNA add_sound)
musica.derechos: in-app music does not cover boosting, sponsored posts or re-uploads; no AI likenesses of real musicians; press-kit images with credit or the artist's permission

estetica: Modern bricolage, not vintage collage: black-and-white photocopy cutout of the artist, fluorescent gaffer tape graded to the palette, Sharpie marks, vinyl stickers, acetate, office hardware, torn paper strips. All color comes from the craft materials; the subject stays black and white. No sepia, aged paper, newspaper clippings or typewriter text.
reglas: Everything on screen and in the voice is in English.
The presenter is a floating art-toy head with no hands: every gesture is a face or head move.
Funny hook first (the strangest true detail), then who/where/when on the bricolage portrait.
The artwork is the star of every B line: slow drifts, magnifier cards on details, a zoom-out reveal; never a static still.
Facts are checked against a source before publishing (the source scripts still need it).
Captions on every second: Poppins SemiBold, 2-4 words per group, the spoken word in amber.
Close with a two-option question, 'tell me in the comments' with the CTA pill, and a last joke.
Music is added in the app, not in the export.
No brand logo in the video; no AI likeness of real musicians.
Never publish ccc through the Cult Pixel connections; ccc has its own accounts (not connected yet).
